LAW_BASIS: [013] current explicit user operational directive outranks active Constitution and canonical control state.
[039]-[041] require expected-version CAS and monotonic STATE_VERSION on every authoritative Mission Fence mutation.
[043]-[044] require immutable transition intent before entry CAS and binding of transition generation/id/hash/state.
[046] permits USER_STOP to preempt any non-terminal global transition.
[048] makes Bootstrap Fence coordinate legacy authority freeze/drain and USER_STOP before Mission Fence genesis.
[053]-[056] define stable legacy-admission freeze and zero unresolved legacy mutation/integration authority as deterministic authority evidence.
[080] defines MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH as global bulk invalidation.
[121]-[123] make ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH authority bindings whose changes stale old leases/memberships.
[133] binds integration intents to ENGINEERING_EPOCH and owner membership authority.
[164]-[168] require immediate/preemptive USER_STOP while preserving durable integration/Git truth.
[165]-[166] select Bootstrap Fence before genesis and Mission Fence after genesis.

COMMON_STOP_INTENT.HASH_DOMAIN: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS(stop intent object excluding its own hash field)
COMMON_STOP_INTENT.PURPOSE: Bind the exact authority state being preempted before STOP entry; retries reuse the same intent only while its expected fence version still matches.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.STOP_LINEARIZATION_POINT_AFTER_MISSION_F: The successful Mission Fence expected-version STOP entry CAS that binds the immutable STOP intent, closes all gates, and increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH plus MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.PREGENESIS_USER_AUTHORITY_LINEARIZATION: The explicit USER_STOP directive immediately removes mission authorization at operational-authority level; Bootstrap STOP entry durably records that revocation and starts deterministic legacy-authority freeze/reconciliation. Surviving legacy records cannot be treated as authorized progress after that directive.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.POST_STOP_PHYSICAL_ARTIFACT_RULE: Durable stale worker or legacy writes may physically appear after authority revocation. They are unauthorized/noncanonical evidence only and can never create integration-ready, ACTIVE_INTEGRATION, or verified mission progress.

STOP_INTENT_BINDING: Create immutable Bootstrap USER_STOP intent before entry CAS.
Bind STOP_INTENT_ID and STOP_INTENT_HASH in the Bootstrap STOP entry CAS together with EXPECTED STATE_VERSION.
ENTRY_CAS: Set/retain legacy admission freeze as mandatory STOP authority state so no compliant legacy participant may receive fresh mutation/integration authority.
Preserve existing legacy freeze request/evidence, legacy inventory, active legacy integration evidence, and ambiguous external truth.
LEGACY_AUTHORITY_DRAIN_AFTER_ENTRY: Enumerate every discovered legacy claim, lease, mutation authority, integration authority, and active integration from the pinned legacy authority inventory plus any canonical deltas discovered during STOP reconciliation.
Revoke, suspend, release, or deterministically reconcile each authority using the currently authoritative legacy/control mechanism; do not invent successful revocation evidence.
Keep legacy admission freeze stable throughout reconciliation.
Any legacy write physically appearing after USER_STOP is unauthorized evidence and must not be promoted as mission progress.
If new legacy authority appears despite the freeze, treat the freeze as failed, remain fail-closed, and record STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED rather than STOPPED.

STOPPED_REQUIRES: zero unresolved discovered legacy mutation authority
zero unresolved discovered legacy integration authority

FORBIDDEN: Mission Fence creation after USER_STOP linearizes.
Legacy drain advancement as normal mission progress.
Product mutation or target integration authority.

PREEMPTION_EVIDENCE: Before replacing ACTIVE_TRANSITION with STOP, persist immutable PREEMPTED_TRANSITION_EVIDENCE containing prior TRANSITION_KIND, TRANSITION_GENERATION, ACTIVE_TRANSITION_ID, ACTIVE_TRANSITION_INTENT_HASH, ACTIVE_TRANSITION_STATE, and any transition-specific durable evidence pointers.
If no prior transition is active, record an explicit NONE preemption value.
ENTRY_CAS_PRECONDITIONS: Use exact expected MISSION_FENCE_STATE.STATE_VERSION from COMMON_STOP_INTENT.
Verify COMMON_STOP_INTENT still matches observed preemption target; a stale expected version aborts and requires resync/new intent.
USER_STOP may preempt any non-terminal transition and does not wait for routine work.
ATOMIC_WRITES: Bind PREEMPTED_TRANSITION_EVIDENCE_ID/hash without erasing the preempted transition artifact.
AUTHORITY_EFFECT: Every pre-stop lease becomes stale through ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH changes.
Every pre-stop ACTIVE membership loses mutation authority through MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH change.
Every queued/not-yet-active pre-stop integration intent becomes stale through its ENGINEERING_EPOCH and owner membership bindings.
ACTIVE_INTEGRATION remains durable truth requiring reconciliation rather than silent deletion.

REPEATED_USER_STOP_IDEMPOTENCY: If the active transition is already STOPPING and the same STOP_INTENT_ID/hash is bound, repeated delivery is an append-only duplicate-stop evidence event; do not create a second active STOP transition or increment epochs again solely for duplicate delivery.
If Mission/Bootstrap state is already STOPPED or STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, record the repeated request as evidence only and keep all gates closed.
If a different stale STOP intent targets an older fence STATE_VERSION, its entry CAS fails; resync rather than creating competing STOP authority.
POST_STOP_ADMISSION_RULES: No new normal work/task/resource lease may be granted.
No stale lease may be renewed into mutation eligibility.
No queued integration intent created before STOP may be reserved as ACTIVE_INTEGRATION after STOP.
No new integration intent may be created as authorized mission progress.
Read-only reconciliation/audit may continue only to preserve truth and determine STOPPED versus STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
ACTIVE_INTEGRATION_STOP_RULE: USER_STOP never nulls or overwrites ACTIVE_INTEGRATION merely to make state appear stopped.
If ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is provably NOT_COMMITTED, preserve evidence and mark its mission authority preempted/stale.
If Git ref may have moved or state is REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS, COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, or otherwise ambiguous, reconcile actual Git truth using [142]-[145].
If reconciliation cannot prove a safe terminal result, final state is STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
No unrelated integration is admitted during reconciliation.
LOCAL_VALIDATOR_HARDENING: Before starting each concrete mutation operation, reread authoritative fence state and require MISSION_STATUS not STOPPING/STOPPED, MUTATION_GATE=OPEN, and lease ENGINEERING_EPOCH/MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH equal fence values.
This reduces stale physical writes but is not the authority linearization mechanism; the STOP CAS epoch invalidation is authoritative.
Never claim physical sink-level no-write atomicity unless the actual mutation sink supplies such an atomic fence primitive.
STOP_COMPLETION: After all mandatory legacy or ACTIVE_INTEGRATION reconciliation for the applicable fence kind, transition by expected-version CAS to STOPPED or STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
Keep ACTIVE_TRANSITION STOP identity and preempted-transition evidence durable or move them to explicit terminal stop evidence without erasure.
Do not reset ENGINEERING_EPOCH, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, TRANSITION_GENERATION, or STATE_VERSION.
TORTURE_TESTS_REQUIRED: Worker revalidates immediately before Mission STOP CAS, then attempts a worker-branch write after STOP.
Queued integration intent races Mission STOP entry.
USER_STOP preempts each global transition kind and preserves exact preempted transition identity.
USER_STOP during each ACTIVE_INTEGRATION phase including REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS.
Legacy V11 lease/claim remains active when Bootstrap USER_STOP arrives.
Fresh legacy authority issuance attempt races Bootstrap legacy admission freeze.
Unknown legacy integration authority prevents STOPPED and yields STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
Repeated identical USER_STOP during STOPPING and after STOPPED.
Stale STOP intent attempts entry after fence STATE_VERSION changed.

V1_REVIEW_FINDING_DISPOSITION.GAP_PREGENESIS_LEGACY_AUTHORITY_INVALIDA: ADDRESSED by mandatory stable legacy admission freeze, full discovered authority reconciliation, and STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED when zero cannot be proven.
V1_REVIEW_FINDING_DISPOSITION.GAP_MISSION_STOP_TRANSITION_IDENTITY: ADDRESSED by immutable STOP intent, mandatory ACTIVE_TRANSITION_ID/HASH/STATE binding, and separate preserved preempted-transition evidence.

STRONGER_GUARANTEE_BOUNDARY: If terminal semantics are interpreted to require that no physical worker or legacy Git write can appear after authority revocation, V16-RC1.3 lacks a sink-level atomic primitive coupling fence CAS to all isolated Git writes. V2 guarantees authoritative revocation/canonical exclusion, not impossible physical side effects from stale/noncompliant actors.
